name: Card
layerWhy: It is one item of a collection; the collection, not the card, does a job.
promise: I am one of several, and you can open me.
expectation: A raised box among others like it, the whole box a target.
evidence: It is drawn only inside a list of cards; the title link covers it; its payload stays and wraps while metadata marked data-gives-way goes first.
behaviour: The whole card opens; buttons inside sit above that cover.
context: Collections people open: reports, issues, products. Never a page, a section, or a lone piece of content.
relationships: Siblings compare; a dynamic list of one is still a list.
accessibility: A list item with a heading link; the ring goes round the card.
failures: Never a single child or a page container.
do: Name its payload; mark what can give way.
